[!buildmode:shared] skip
[short] skip
[!cgo] skip '-buildmode=shared requires external linking'

env GO111MODULE=off
env CGO_ENABLED=1

# -trimpath should keep GOROOT out of shared libraries too.
go install -trimpath -buildmode=shared -pkgdir=$WORK/pkgdir runtime
go build -trimpath -linkshared -pkgdir=$WORK/pkgdir -o goroot$GOEXE goroot.go
env GOROOT=
exec ./goroot$GOEXE
stderr '^GOROOT=$'

-- goroot.go --
package main

import "runtime"

func main() {
	println("GOROOT=" + runtime.GOROOT())
}
